session.status: A full trading session. The levels below are Thursday 26 November 2026's own close, verified on the day against two independent sources. Next session: Friday 27 November 2026

sources: Nifty 50 close 25,884.50 (+65.25, +0.25%) and Sensex close 84,328.59 (+390.31, +0.46%) — PTI's closing report for 26 Nov 2026, carried by The Hindu, The Hindu BusinessLine, The Tribune and Rediff Moneynews; and the closing reports of Business Standard, NDTV Profit, ET Now, CNBC TV18, Moneycontrol and Upstox (which cites NSE data), all dated 26 Nov 2026, which give the identical two closes

Session shape (Sensex high 84,551.74, +613.46; Nifty high 25,974.95; Bank Nifty 63,535.30, -167.95, -0.26%; Nifty Midcap 100 +0.32%, Nifty Smallcap 100 +0.74%; India VIX 17.35, -1.75%) — PTI via The Tribune, Moneycontrol's 26 Nov 2026 session report, NDTV Profit's 26 Nov 2026 market wrap and HDFC Sky's 26 Nov 2026 note

Why the indices rose, and why they gave back part of the gain (sustained foreign fund inflows and buying in information technology, realty and metal shares, against profit-booking, crude oil back above $95 a barrel and the US proposing a 25% tariff on Indian goods) — PTI via The Tribune, Reuters via Business Recorder and MSN, Moneycontrol's 26 Nov 2026 report and Business Standard's 26 Nov 2026 market blog

USD / INR 92.44 — PTI's provisional closing report for 26 Nov 2026, carried by The Hindu, The Hindu BusinessLine, Rediff Moneynews and PTI's own wire, which states the rupee 'settled 24 paise lower at 92.44 (provisional)' after opening at 92.50 and trading between 92.31 and 92.66; and Moneycontrol's USD/INR page for 26 November 2026, updated 16:17 IST, which shows 92.4400. Two independent sources carry 92.44, so that is the level published. Reuters' intraday report had the rupee at 92.56 at 10:30 IST and other feeds show 92.31 to 92.55 through the session; this page publishes the level two sources agree on rather than averaging the spread. Against the 92.23 recorded on this page for the previous session that is +0.21 (+0.23%); PTI measures 24 paise from its own previous close of 92.20

Gold 24K 999 ₹1,22,982 per 10 g and silver 999 ₹1,46,933 per kg — IBJA's 26 Nov 2026 AM benchmark (12:00 IST), published on ibjarates.com and reported at those exact figures by Bhavflow's IBJA benchmark page for 26 November 2026, Samachar Manch's IBJA AM rate report, ETV Bharat, Bhaskar English, Roz Bhav, TrackLivePrice and LetsInvest. Against the previous working session's AM benchmark of ₹1,21,310 and ₹1,43,522 that is +₹1,672 (+1.38%) and +₹3,411 (+2.38%). IBJA's 26 Nov PM fixing was not published at the time of this refresh, so the AM benchmark is used throughout, as on every previous day

One caution recorded for the reader's benefit: several retail rate pages quote 26 November figures of about ₹1,21,910 per 10 g for gold and ₹1,43,770 per kg for silver (NDTV Profit's Bullion.co.in feed) or city retail rates of about ₹1,22,930 and ₹1,47,180 (Mint, Delhi). Those are dealer and city rates, not the IBJA benchmark this page uses, and they are not used here. A rate page that still shows the previous day's IBJA fixing (sonabhav.in, stamped 25 Nov 2026, 5:15 pm) was also not used
